lessons.title: Catch the high C sunbeam
lessons.story: A high C sunbeam is shining through the top of the garden.
lessons.childCue: Cover thumb and hole 2, then let high C shine.
lessons.adultCue: Keep the guide tone off while listening and accept a comfortable, unforced attempt.
lessons.successCue: The high C sunbeam found you!
tips: Thumb and finger 2 make high C.
